doc.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011

title: Marrying a piano player in 1942
summary: Congratulations on nearly 70 years together; Iola recalls marrying at 19 and her parents' reaction.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I have to tell you I will do a good deal of bragging to my jazz circles that I’ve been in the Brubeck house twice now. It’s a real pleasure for me. And I wanted to congratulate you on your almost-70 years together as a couple, is that right?
That’s right. We were married in 1942.
Can you remember if your parents were excited about you marrying a piano player?

I don’t think they were too aware of the hazards involved, and they liked Dave personally. And of course we were both very young. I think they were a little questioning that perhaps. But he was only 21 and I had my 19th birthday in August and we were married in September.
Were you aware of the hazards of the music profession?
